verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry with server pages where users can discover servers. Its CLI documented registry search and tool search "by name or intent," and the shutdown notice says Smithery remains a public MCP registry. However, the CLI that provided capability search was shut down and deprecated on October 31, 2026, and the evidence documents no replacement web search by capability. Missing for 10: currently working search-by-capability (the CLI search is deprecated), documented web catalog search and filtering, and explicit evidence of catalog size beyond the "top 100 servers" scan.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: smithery mcp search [term]              # Search the Smithery registry
smithery tool find [query]             # Search tools by name or intent
Get a dedicated server page where users can discover, try, and install your MCP from any client
Smithery will remain as a public (non-proxied) MCP registry.
